stateKeys.name: expenseId
stateKeys.type: string, the expense's business id ('' before START)

stateKeys.name: reason
stateKeys.type: string, why the run ended without paying ('' otherwise)

specialRules.name: stale-completions-reject
specialRules.note: A completion arriving in any state other than the one that awaits it is an observable rejection (post == pre), never a fault: a late approval after the window closed, a duplicate payment result.
specialRules.whenAction: CREATED | CREATE_FAILED | APPROVE | REJECT | APPROVAL_TIMEOUT | PAID | PAY_FAILED

noOpRule: An action that does not apply in the current state is reject(reason) - an observable no-op with post == pre.
